items.title: Improving health intelligence in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant, enhancing ChatGPT's ability to provide health and wellness responses. The update focuses on stronger reasoning, improved context comprehension, clearer communication, and incorporates insights from physician evaluations. This marks a significant step in AI's application in healthcare, aiming to deliver more accurate and reliable information to users.
items.why_it_matters: Improved AI in healthcare can lead to better assistance and decision-making tools for medical professionals.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available
items.summary: Amazon has announced the general availability of its Bedrock AgentCore harness, allowing developers to quickly set up production-grade AI agents with just two API calls: CreateHarness and InvokeHarness. The agents operate in isolated environments, providing a robust framework for complex task automation.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Async Inference now supports inline request payloads
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker's AI Async Inference now supports inline request payloads, allowing developers to send inference data directly in the request body of the InvokeEndpointAsync API. This update eliminates the need to upload data to Amazon S3, streamlining the inference process.

items.title: Diffusion Language Models: An Experimental Analysis
items.summary: A new paper on arXiv explores Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) as an alternative to the autoregressive generation approach in traditional LLMs. The study examines how DLMs can achieve similar performance with potentially different computational characteristics.
